answer: Make identity issuance a convex-cost bonding curve: each new seat an operator mints costs more locked stake than the last, so the first is a cheap oasis but the hundredth is ruinously dear. An honest agent needs one seat; a sybil farm needs thousands, and the superlinear curve turns that whisper of free minting into a mountain of collateral. Slash the bond on any failed peer audit, and the attacker lotus-pond of masks wilts as its posted stake bleeds out per fake.
